title: Chic 2 bed 2 bath, in 12 South
description:
Welcome to the Chic  2 bedroom 2 bathroom , our recently remodeled two-bedroom, two-bathroom retreat in the lively 12South neighborhood of Nashville, TN! 

 This home provides a private escape with a unique charm. Enjoy the convenience of a private entrance and free parking at the front of the property, steps away from your entryway.

The space
Hello Guests the layout of our home is as follows : 
Living dining and kitchen on first level 
Full bath standup shower on the first level 
Upstairs two bedrooms one on the right one on the left , Master has an in-suite  bath .

Guest access
You will be sent a code and directions on how to use our smart lock to the message thread on your reservation on check in day . The code is time based on your reservation .

Other things to note
You must be ok with stairs
